_note: Seed for the Results tab, 2026-09-22: Q1FY27 sell-side previews and prints
lifted VERBATIM from the vault's Broker Mail digests (the extraction corpus).
Every row's quote is the digest sentence; as_of is the digest date.
ONLY NUMBERS THE SOURCE STATES ARE LOADED. 'PAT +6% vs est' implies an
estimate of 32.9cr and '13% ahead' one of 428cr — both DERIVED, neither
written down by the broker, so neither is here. The tab must never carry a
consensus built from arithmetic the source did not do.
Units are the store's canonical ones — INR cr for money lines (Rs41.5bn ->
4,150; Rs349mn -> 34.9), INR/t per tonne, t for volumes (10.5mt ->
10,500,000), % for margins, USD mn for Novelis. The quote keeps the source's
own figure so every conversion is auditable. tata_steel's EBITDA/t is 'INR/t
India' because the stored Q1FY27 print (steel_actuals.json) is India
standalone and Nomura's preview is too; the loader would refuse a bare
'INR/t' against it, correctly — consolidated and standalone are different
Broker-mail digests end 18-08-2026; September mail lives in
data/morning/brief_*.json. Q2FY27 previews (early October) are the first
quarter this tab forecasts LIVE — stage them as they arrive.
